statement:
∀ (b : ℕ) [NeZero b] (k : ZMod b) (w : ZMod b → ℂ),
  let S := fun j : ZMod b =>
    ∑ a : (ZMod b)ˣ, ZMod.stdAddChar (j*(a : ZMod b)+k*(↑(a⁻¹) : ZMod b));
  (∑ a : (ZMod b)ˣ, w (a : ZMod b) * ZMod.stdAddChar (k*(↑(a⁻¹) : ZMod b))) =
    (∑ j : ZMod b, ZMod.dft w j * S j)/(b : ℂ) ∧
  (∑ j : ZMod b, ‖S j‖^2) = (b : ℝ)*(Nat.totient b : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0093 · 完全化任意实际权的逆元和并确定完整二阶矩
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0093 · Complete the inverse sum for an arbitrary actual weight and compute the full second moment

brief.zh: 用负号约定的 DFT 逆变换得到正 j 相位，再按单位的标准代表做完全正交。w 可同时携带 p=a²+b² 的素性、动态窗和对数权。
brief.en: Use the inverse transform for the negative-sign DFT to obtain the positive j phase. Apply complete orthogonality to the unit representatives. The weight w can carry primality of p=a²+b², the moving window, and the log weight together.
